description: Turn a song into a 3D world you can explore in the browser and in VR.
tour.play.title: Press play
tour.play.body: The song turns into a 3D world: the notes you hear appear on the staff and shape the scene around you.
tour.layers.title: Choose what you see
tour.layers.body: Open Layers to switch drums, bass, voice, chords, lyrics and effects on or off, or pick a preset.
tour.notes.title: Pause and play with the notes
tour.notes.body: When the song is paused, click a note to hear it, drag it to another line, or add a new line.
tour.vr.title: Step inside in VR
tour.vr.body: On a Quest, open this page in the browser and choose Enter VR to stand inside the world and walk around.
demoHint: No account, no upload: the demo song plays in your browser, with a short tour.
playlist.title: My songs
playlist.private: The songs you played. They are saved in this browser for your account only; nobody else can see them.
playlist.empty: Nothing played yet. Open the demo or upload a song.
